  var linkPath = linkUrl.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "");
  var currentPath = currentUrl.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "");

    linkPath === currentPath;

  // Normalize trailing slashes
  var linkPath = linkUrl.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "");
  var currentPath = currentUrl.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "");

  var isSamePage =

    linkPath === currentPath;

  // Normalize trailing slashes
